visual_logic.composition: The scene illustrates three distinct feeding heights in one frame. AT THE BOTTOM: A wide, armored Ankylosaurus is munching on a patch of small green ferns at its feet. IN THE MIDDLE: A Therizinosaurus uses its long neck and claws to reach the fronds of a cycad tree (about head-height for a human). AT THE TOP: The massive neck of an Argentinosaurus enters the frame from the side, with its head reaching the very top of a towering Araucaria tree to eat the needle-leaves. The different heights are clearly separated and easy for a child to distinguish.
